encoding: Each sample is a line template with a {{V}} marker and the secret as pieces: {l: literal} for separators and short shape prefixes, {r: charset, n: length} for the random part (D digits, H lower hex, X upper hex, L lower, U upper, l lower+digits, u upper+digits, A alphanumeric). The fuzz test rebuilds a value of the same shape with its seeded generator, so no secret-shaped literal sits in the repo.
